simple.summary: קְנָא (qᵉnâʼ) means to purchase First listed occurrence: Ezra 7 17.

definitions.full: H7066. qena [ קְנָא ] verb acquire, buy (see Biblical Hebrew I. קנה ); — Pe`al Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּקְנֵא Ezra 7:17 with accusative of thing, + בְּכַסְמָּא .
